value.name: Asha confronts drawer search
value.description: Asha remarks that Daniel has searched every drawer in the house, signaling her awareness of his intrusive search.
evidence: "You have been through every drawer in this house," Asha said, evenly.

value.name: Daniel explains paperwork search
value.description: Daniel says he has been looking for paperwork such as tax and insurance documents and insists he has searched everywhere.
evidence: "I have been looking for paperwork. Tax stuff. Insurance. I have looked everywhere a person would put paperwork."

value.name: Daniel reveals search began after death
value.description: Under questioning, Daniel admits he started searching after Lucia's death and continued before and after Asha arrived.
evidence: "Since she died. Before you came. After you came. Continuously."

value.name: Lucia presses Daniel for timing
value.description: Lucia interrupts Daniel to demand exactly when he started looking, shifting the exchange into a more accusatory tone.
evidence: "Daniel," Lucia said. Her voice had gone strange and quiet. "When did you start looking."

value.name: Daniel admits searching funeral day after
value.description: Daniel reveals he began searching the day after the funeral, while Lucia was asleep upstairs, and went through her desk.
evidence: "The day after the funeral. I came in. You were asleep upstairs. I went through her desk."
"You went through her desk the day after the funeral."
"I went through her desk the day after the funeral."

value.name: Daniel justifies rummaging through desk
value.description: Daniel defends his actions by saying someone had to handle the bills and paperwork, expressing resentment that the responsibility always falls to him.
evidence: "Because someone had to. Because someone always has to, Lucia, and it is always me, and you can sit upstairs and be sad about it but the bills don't pay themselves."

value.name: Asha questions undisclosed findings
value.description: After a silence, Asha asks whether Daniel found anything in the desk that he has not turned over to her.
evidence: "Daniel," she said, after a moment. "I have to ask. When you went through her desk, did you find anything you have not given me."

value.name: Daniel denies withholding documents
value.description: Daniel looks at Asha and denies finding or keeping anything from her, insisting he has given her everything.

value.name: Asha recognizes Daniel is lying
value.description: Asha privately concludes that Daniel is lying to her and that he is not even good at hiding it.
evidence: "It was not all right. Asha had been a probate attorney for fourteen years and she had watched a great many people lie to her, and Daniel Serrano was lying to her now. He was not even very good at it."
